name: ernadoo/mondial-relay-bundle
description: Mondial Relay Bundle for Symfony 6.4 / 7.x / 8.x: label creation, relay point search and a Stimulus relay point picker

suggest.symfony/rate-limiter: Rate-limits the relay point search endpoint of the "api" picker
suggest.symfony/stimulus-bundle: Required to use the relay point picker (Stimulus controller)
suggest.symfony/stopwatch: Shows Mondial Relay calls in the Profiler's Performance timeline
suggest.symfony/translation: Translates the labels of the "api" picker (English and French provided)
suggest.twig/twig: Required to use the Twig helpers (relay point picker markup)
